goal: Prevent disk space leaks when pruning block files during a failed disk flush
Ensure pending pruned block files are deleted on the next successful flush without requiring a node restart
agreement: Unaddressed objection: retrying manual prune after a failed flush still will not delete files (Yudis-bit)
Unaddressed objection: reallocated block files opened rb+ are not truncated and could corrupt data (Yudis-bit)
Questioned whether files pending deletion can actually be reached for reallocation (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because leaked block files are already cleaned up on node restart
The disk space leak only happens when a flush fails prior to writing the block index
